ai_suggestions_decision_check.name: ai_suggestions_decision_check
ai_suggestions_decision_check.value:
("ai_suggestions"."status" = 'pending') = ("ai_suggestions"."decided_at" is null)
        and ("ai_suggestions"."decided_at" is null) = ("ai_suggestions"."decided_by" is null)

commitments_erasure_check.name: commitments_erasure_check
commitments_erasure_check.value:
("commitments"."erased_at" is null and "commitments"."salt" is not null and "commitments"."value" is not null)
        or ("commitments"."erased_at" is not null and "commitments"."salt" is null and "commitments"."value" is null)

notifications_alert_recipient_check.name: notifications_alert_recipient_check
notifications_alert_recipient_check.value:
("notifications"."recipient_kind" = 'alertRecipient') = ("notifications"."alert_recipient_id" is not null)
        and ("notifications"."alert_recipient_id" is null or "notifications"."alert_recipient_id" = "notifications"."recipient_id")

notifications_failed_check.name: notifications_failed_check
notifications_failed_check.value:
("notifications"."status" = 'failed') = ("notifications"."failed_at" is not null)
        and ("notifications"."status" = 'failed') = ("notifications"."failure" is not null)

tenant_ai_keys_resource_name_check.name: tenant_ai_keys_resource_name_check
tenant_ai_keys_resource_name_check.value:
("tenant_ai_keys"."provider" = 'azure_openai') = ("tenant_ai_keys"."resource_name" is not null)
        and ("tenant_ai_keys"."resource_name" is null or "tenant_ai_keys"."resource_name" ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,62}[a-z0-9]$')

tenant_ai_keys_endpoint_region_check.name: tenant_ai_keys_endpoint_region_check
tenant_ai_keys_endpoint_region_check.value:
("tenant_ai_keys"."provider" in ('openai', 'azure_openai')) = ("tenant_ai_keys"."endpoint_region" is not null)
        and ("tenant_ai_keys"."endpoint_region" is null or "tenant_ai_keys"."endpoint_region" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9]{1,39}$')

tenants_ai_key_reference_check.name: tenants_ai_key_reference_check
tenants_ai_key_reference_check.value:
("tenants"."ai_provider" = 'platform_default') = ("tenants"."ai_key_reference" is null)
        and ("tenants"."ai_key_reference" is null or "tenants"."ai_key_reference" ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9/_.:-]{0,199}$')

uploads_scan_finding_check.name: uploads_scan_finding_check
uploads_scan_finding_check.value:
("uploads"."scan_status" = 'flagged') = ("uploads"."scan_finding" is not null)
        and ("uploads"."scan_finding" is null
             or "uploads"."scan_finding" in ('malware', 'scanLimitExceeded', 'pdfActiveContent', 'contentChanged'))
